_comment: PLACEHOLDER baseline tool config. Tool-optimization target (docs/verified-capabilities.md §3b): the optimizer refines DESCRIPTIONS only, never type/required/defaults. The fabric_iq_preview tool is the verified Foundry tool type (§2a); server_url is a Fabric IQ MCP ontology endpoint. Real project_connection_id / server_url values come from config/env (.env), never committed (Art. VI). Phase 5 finalises wiring.

tools.description: Query the Fabric IQ ontology (preview) for the water-utility domain. Ask in business terms about entities (WaterSource, WaterTreatmentPlant, AlgalMonitoringStation, WaterQualityMetric), their properties, and relationships (monitors, supplies, records). Returns ontology-grounded answers routed via NL2Ontology over bound OneLake sources, in the signed-in user's context.
